title: Arkret Durable Device Revocation State
description: Durable exact-device revocation fence. A receiver that knows this authenticated pending/revoked state blocks affected new live actions locally. Unknown remote revocation can have a propagation window for ordinary data. Fresh proof issue is not a separate Event admission action. Terminal safety outcomes preserve exact transaction, authorization and generation binding.

device_revocation_gate_record.description: Gate-relevant durable state for an exact device generation. Rejected records are audit history and are excluded; pending and revoked records remain visible together so committing one transaction cannot hide another surviving pending transaction.

device_generation_ref.description: Reducer-derived PCR-local monotonic current device-generation selector. A producer MUST NOT self-report it and it MUST NOT equal or be derived from a DID versionId.

denied_actions.description: Closed canonical action-class list blocked by revocation_pending on every deployment.

target_device_authorize_event_id.description: Reducer-derived accepted ak.device.authorize Event targeted by this proposal.

proposal_event_id.description: The complete accepted revoke Event identifier and the sole wire source of that Event digest. Consumers recover the digest from this identifier when validating a terminal decision; this record MUST NOT duplicate it as a sibling field.

accepted_at.description: Actual durable atomic-commit time assigned when the Event, derived selectors and pending index commit. It is assigned by the authority transaction and MUST NOT be producer supplied.

acceptance_seq.description: Monotonic sequence assigned by the origin Station in the same atomic commit as accepted_at and the pending index.

device_revocation_gate_check_request_bod.description: Authenticated S2S request from an Account Authority or another registered issuer to the exact origin Station. The exact authorization Event and PCR-local generation are derived from the origin's locked durable current device projection. expected selectors are issuer-verified, appear together or not at all, and MAY be omitted only for session_grant_issue or returning_session_grant_issue. device_pairing_code_claim MUST carry both selectors from the Account Authority-verified Standard SessionGrant device_binding after exact HTTP DPoP verification; that grant snapshot does not itself authorize the claim. returning_session_grant_issue and human session_grant_refresh require AcceptedDevicePossessionProof; registration/recovery session_grant_issue and device_pairing_code_claim forbid that proof. The code-claim action is distinct from event_write and binds only a current-device eligibility decision; the origin never receives or reads the pairing ledger.

intent_digest.description: Digest of the complete immutable issue or refresh intent, including the exact grant id, jti, subject, device, audience, scope, holder binding, issued_at and expiry; for device_pairing_code_claim it is the digest of the operation id, exact AccountId, caller device id and canonical code-claim request. The Account Authority sends only this digest, never the plaintext pairing code, to the origin Station. Session-grant introspection is read-only issuer-ledger verification and never consumes this receipt.

accepted_device_possession_proof.description: Required only for returning_session_grant_issue and human session_grant_refresh. The origin verifies it with the accepted device key from the same locked durable projection used to decide current authorization. Registration/recovery session_grant_issue and Agent runtime issuers MUST omit it.

device_revocation_gate_decision_receipt.description: Origin-Station durable decision made under its local device lock. Shared revocation becomes effective only through its authority-committed Event; this internal receipt carries no Control Proposal or RealmCommit witness.

target_device_authorize_event_id.description: Origin-derived current device authorization Event. Present only for allow.

target_device_generation_ref.description: Origin-derived current device generation. Present only for allow.

accepted_device_possession_proof_digest.description: Present for human SessionGrant issue/refresh allow or block after proof validation; SHA-256 of the exact canonical AcceptedDevicePossessionProof. It cryptographically binds the gate decision to the proof verified under the locked current accepted-device key.

linearization_seq.description: Monotonic sequence from the origin Station's durable device-revocation log.

expires_at.description: Hard receipt-use deadline no later than 30 seconds after linearized_at. It is a freshness bound, not a cache TTL and not a revocation deadline.

device_revocation_gate_check_outcome.description: Response of ak.peer.device_revocations.command.check.v1. The origin Station returns exactly one linearization receipt over the deployment-internal authenticated channel; the outcome adds no signature layer of its own.
